prompt_text: Who is the best HVAC company in Houston for AC repair?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” HVAC company for everyone — the right choice depends on your location in Houston, whether you need emergency service, if it’s a homeowner or commercial job, your budget, and whether your system is still under manufacturer warranty. I can find the top-rated providers near you, but first a few quick questions so I give the best recommendation:

- What Houston ZIP code are you in?  
- Is this a residential or commercial system?  
- Is it an emergency (no cooling now) or can it wait for a scheduled visit?  
- Do you have a brand/model still under warranty or prefer a specific brand/tech (Carrier, Trane, etc.)?

While you answer, here’s a short checklist you can use to vet any HVAC company:

- Licensing & insurance: Ask for the contractor license and proof of liability insurance.  
- Certifications: Look for NATE-certified technicians and manufacturer dealer certifications (if you want warranty service).  
- Reviews & reputation: Check Google/Yelp, BBB, and local Facebook groups for recent reviews.  
- Written estimate: Get a written, itemized estimate before work begins (parts, labor, diagnostic fee).  
- Warranties & maintenance: Ask about labor and part warranties and whether they offer maintenance plans.  
- Upfront pricing & diagnostics: Ask how they charge (flat rate vs. hourly) and if diagnostic fees are credited toward repair.  
- Permits & compliance: For major replacements, confirm the company will pull necessary permits and provide system sizing (Manual J) and proper installation.

If you want, I’ll pull a short list (3–5) of highly rated AC repair companies near your ZIP code with contact info, average ratings, and any notes about specialties or warranty service. Which ZIP code should I use?
